title: Find the knee
intro: A GuideLLM sweep measured p99 request latency at rising request rates.
prompt: Where has the deployment blown past its capacity knee?
debrief:
Latency is nearly flat, then explodes — the queueing knee. Between 16 and 32 rps this deployment ran out of capacity and p99 went from 340 ms to 2.4 s. This is why you run a **sweep** before launch: find the knee, set the autoscaling threshold left of it, and never discover it from a pager.
